content:
maya: Quick sync: we need a minimal GA acceptance checklist for the Slicing feature. Focus: SLA tiers, who owns docs, a short burn-in, monitoring thresholds, and a pricing approach. Target: EOD Friday.

sam: Question  can we assume current infra for initial GA? If not, SLA numbers change and we need cost sign-off.

leo: If we keep current infra baseline, p95 ~160ms under expected load. Anything below ~150ms needs extra pools.

maya: Legal note: any contract >$100k requires 99.9% SLA. That means enterprise offerings must meet that. Self-serve can have lower capped SLOs.

olivia: I'll own public docs (Quickstart + Runbook). Need a short smoke-test snippet from eng.

nina: I'll run the canary (setup + metrics). Proposing 48-72h burn-in with staged traffic ramp. Creating ticket RH-5050 and assigning to myself.

sam: Pricing proposal: default usage-based for self-serve + reserved commit option for enterprise. OLivia/FinOps to propose numbers.

maya: Monitoring: require three automated signals: p95 latency, error rate, and queue depth. Fallback: route to smaller quantized model if p95 >200ms for 10m OR error-rate >1% for 5m.

leo: Add alert: if queue depth >800 for 5m -> autoscale and page SRE. Include runbook links.

olivia: Docs checklist: Quickstart, Runbook, SLO table, Pricing FAQ, Known limitations. I'll draft the Pricing FAQ and example calculator snippet.

maya: Owners recap: SLA/legal  sam; Docs  olivia; Canary/burn-in  nina; Monitoring/alerts  leo; Pricing numbers  olivia + finops. Confirm?

sam: Confirmed. Looping legal + finance now.

nina: Confirmed. Canary start target: Friday 09:00 PT.

leo: Confirmed. Will add alert defs + short rollback steps to runbook.

product-bot: Reminder: add owner matrix to GA checklist doc: https://redwood.work/docs/ga-checklist (section "Launch safety nets").

maya: Action items: sam  legal/finance check (Thu EOD); nina  canary ticket + checklist (Thu EOD); olivia  docs + pricing draft (Thu midday); leo  alerts + runbook (Thu midday). Ping if blocked.

sam: Will update thread with any constraint notes from legal/finops.

maya: We'll reconvene Friday 10am PT if anything outstanding. Thanks.
